title: Chinese spy balloon over the Aleutians and Montana probing radar limits

tellings.quote: It's like that whole story with in Chinese spy by balloon, well, you know, it seems this was in 2023, January 2023, when this ball appeared. She flew over Aleutian islands in Alaska.

plain: Michels suggests the Chinese spy balloon that appeared in January 2023, flying over Alaska's Aleutian Islands and later over Montana, near Malmstrom Air Force Base, was probing the limits of American radar. He offers this as his own reading, without naming a source. If true, it would mean the balloon was mapping what US defences could and could not see.
